response.sql: WITH group_counts AS (SELECT link_to_major, COUNT(*) as member_count FROM member WHERE link_to_major IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_major), total_and_groups AS (SELECT SUM(member_count) as total_members, COUNT(*) as num_groups, 1.0 / COUNT(*) as avg_share FROM group_counts), shares AS (SELECT gc.link_to_major, gc.member_count, CAST(gc.member_count AS FLOAT) / tag.total_members as share, tag.avg_share FROM group_counts gc CROSS JOIN total_and_groups tag) SELECT SUM(member_count) as total_members, AVG(share) as avg_share, AVG(share - avg_share) as avg_distance_above_avg FROM shares WHERE share > avg_share
